ceiling_statement: The maximum any feasible H1-H8 system can achieve in self-falsification is: (1) every committed positive claim P carries at least one executable falsifier f whose failure refutes P; (2) adversarial adequacy is certified as 100% mutation-kill over a DECLARED, hash-committed, finite class M of mutation operators and counter-design generators, with the kill matrix itself a release artifact recomputable offline (H8); (3) every hypothesis, mutant, or counter-design outside M — including any surviving mutant — is a typed UNKNOWN that fail-closed blocks release (H2/H3) and escalates to the accountable human authority as a certificate-carrying transition (H6). No feasible system can certify refutation-completeness over the open class of all possible defects.
derivation: Computability: by Rice's theorem, every non-trivial semantic property of the system's own code is undecidable, so no total procedure can decide 'this design has no superior counter-design' or 'no undetected defect exists'. Verification theory (Popper asymmetry): universal correctness claims are only refutable, never verifiable; therefore the strongest coherent artifact is a corroboration certificate RELATIVE to an enumerable falsifier class, and the class must be committed (hashed) or the certificate is unfalsifiable itself. Consistency: a system that graded its own falsifiers without an externally recomputable kill-matrix would be trusting a declared root, violating H8; a system that continued past a surviving mutant would silently degrade, violating H3. Hence the ceiling is exactly: committed-finite-class kill-completeness + typed-UNKNOWN + fail-closed escalation, and nothing feasible today exceeds it.
attainment_mechanism: Buildable now in SBCL+OS+crypto: (a) extend the existing mutation-kill harness authority-v2/proofs/capture-mutation-witness.py from the capture area to a repo-wide committed mutation-operator registry (an s-expression listing operators + target seats, hashed into the census systems/orchestrator-epistemic/artifact-census.lisp and chained via prev_release_root); (b) authority-v2/run-proofs.sh (already an un-gameable honesty gate per verify-proof-manifest.py) gains a conjunct: kill(M,F)=100% or exit nonzero — a surviving mutant emits a typed UNKNOWN record and blocks; (c) counter-designs are generated deterministically as ablated variants via source/legal-counterfactual.lisp (counterfactual ablation already exists) and each variant must be distinguished by some falsifier; (d) escalation = append-only dialogue entry under deployment/collab/dialogue/ plus a blocked transition certificate per authority-v2/schema/transition-certificate.cddl, so only the creator's explicit approval unblocks (H6). All components are present in B0; only the registry commitment and the repo-wide wiring are new code.
b0_gap: B0 already has the strongest pieces (map §2: mutation-kill suites, counterfactual ablation, un-false-greenable honesty gate) but three defects keep it below ceiling (map §3 AX-10 residual): (1) systems/orchestrator-omega-modules/frbr-conditions.lisp offers use-default / use-default-content restarts that inject empty or synthesized content and CONTINUE — silent degradation that fabricates a passing state, directly violating H3; (2) the constitutional gate (source/constitutional-gate.lisp evaluate) fails OPEN on predicate error, so an adversarial finding can slip through the very barrier meant to escalate it; (3) mutation-kill exists only over the authority-v2 capture area, not over the Lisp trusted path, and kill-completeness is not itself a committed, offline-recomputable release artifact — today's adequacy claim is a script result, not a certificate.
lean_obligation: Given a finite committed operator class M : Finset Mutation, a falsifier suite F : Finset Falsifier, a system S, and a release relation Admit : System -> KillMatrix -> Prop, prove: theorem kill_gate_sound_and_fail_closed : (Admit S K -> (forall m ∈ M, exists f ∈ F, runs f (apply m S) = FAIL) ∧ recompute K (M, F, S) = K) ∧ ((exists m ∈ M, forall f ∈ F, runs f (apply m S) ≠ FAIL) -> ¬ Admit S K ∧ verdict S = UNKNOWN_escalated). I.e., admission implies recomputable 100% kill, and any surviving mutant implies blocked-with-typed-UNKNOWN; there is no third outcome.
